login.title: Sign in to Kurul
login.subtitle: Use your email and password to continue.
login.error: Could not sign in. Check your email and password.

register.subtitle: Start with a name, email, and password.
register.name: Name
register.error: Could not create your account. Check your details and try again.

email.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address.
email.alreadyExists: This email address is already in use. Sign in instead, or use a different address.

password.tooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters long.

invite.title: Accept invitation
invite.subtitle: You've been invited to join {workspace}.
invite.signInFirst: Sign in with the invited email to accept.
invite.forbidden: This invitation was sent to a different address. Sign in as the invited address to accept it.
invite.loadError: This invitation is no longer available. Ask for a new one.
invite.confirmBody: Invitations can only be accepted from a confirmed address. Send a link to {email} and open it — you'll come straight back here.

confirmEmail.successBody: Your address is confirmed. You can accept workspace invitations from it now.
confirmEmail.pendingBody: A confirmed address is what lets you accept workspace invitations. Everything else in Kurul works without it.

emailConfirmation.sentTo: A new link is on its way to {email}. It's good for a short while.
emailConfirmation.sentIfRegistered: If that address has an unconfirmed account, a new link is on its way.
emailConfirmation.sendError: Could not send the link. Try again in a moment.

linkErrors.TOKEN_EXPIRED: This link has expired. Confirmation links are short-lived, so send yourself a new one.
linkErrors.INVALID_TOKEN: This link isn't valid. It may have been used already, or copied without its last characters — send yourself a new one.
linkErrors.USER_NOT_FOUND: There's no account for the address in this link.
linkErrors.unknown: This link couldn't be checked. Send yourself a new one.

errors.notFoundBody: The link may be out of date, or what it pointed at was deleted.

shell.title: Kurul
shell.navigationDescription: Switch workspace, open the dashboard or settings, and sign out.

language.title: Language
language.description: Choose the language Kurul speaks to you in. It applies everywhere you sign in, and to the email we send you.
language.label: Interface language
language.help: New boards start with columns named in this language. Columns you already have keep their names.
language.saveErrorSignedOut: Your session ended. Sign in to save this.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: What reaches your inbox. Notifications inside Kurul are not affected.
notifications.emailLabel: Email me when I am assigned to a card, mentioned in a comment, or a card of mine is due soon
notifications.help: Only applies on a server that can send email. Each notification is one message; there is no daily summary yet.
notifications.saveError: Could not save your notification settings.
notifications.saveErrorSignedOut: Your session ended. Sign in to save this.

members.title: Members
members.description: Who can open this workspace, and what they can do once they are in it.
members.loadError: The people in this workspace couldn't load.

roleHints.ADMIN: Invite people, manage boards and columns.
roleHints.MEMBER: Create and move tasks on every board.
roleHints.GUEST: Read the boards, and nothing else.

members.inviteNotDelivered: Invitation created, but no email went to {email}. Use Copy link to send it to them yourself.
members.inviteErrorAddress: That address can't be invited. Check it, or ask them to sign in with the address they already use.
members.inviteErrorForbidden: You need admin access to invite people. Ask a workspace owner.
members.inviteErrorConflict: Someone changed this invitation while you were filling it in. Send it again.
members.inviteErrorTooMany: That's a lot of invitations at once. Wait a minute and send the rest.
members.copyLinkError: The link couldn't be copied. Your browser is blocking it.
members.mailDisabledTitle: Email delivery isn't set up on this server
members.mailDisabledBody: Invitations you send won't reach anyone, and nobody can accept one without confirming their address first. Invite them anyway, then send them the link yourself with Copy link.
members.revokeBody: {email} will not be able to join with the link they were sent. You can invite them again later.
members.revokeErrorForbidden: You need admin access to revoke invitations. Ask a workspace owner.
members.changeRoleErrorForbidden: Only an owner can change ownership. Ask a workspace owner.
members.changeRoleErrorLastOwner: This is the only owner. Make someone else an owner first.
members.changeRoleErrorGone: They are no longer in this workspace.
members.removeBody: They lose every board in this workspace straight away. The tasks and comments they wrote stay.
members.removeErrorForbidden: Only an owner can remove another owner. Ask a workspace owner.
members.removeErrorLastOwner: This is the only owner. Make someone else an owner first.
members.removeErrorGone: They are no longer in this workspace.
members.leaveBody: You lose every board in it. An owner or an admin has to invite you back.
members.leaveError: You couldn't be taken out of this workspace.
members.leaveErrorLastOwner: You're the only owner. Make someone else an owner first, or delete the workspace.

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.description: The workspace's name, and what happens to it.
workspace.name: Name
workspace.renameErrorForbidden: You need admin access to rename the workspace. Ask a workspace owner.
workspace.deleteSectionBody: Deletes every board, task, and comment in it. This cannot be undone.
workspace.deleteBody: Deleting {name} deletes every board, task, and comment in it, for everyone in it. This cannot be undone.
workspace.deleteErrorForbidden: Only an owner can delete this workspace. Ask a workspace owner.

account.title: Account
account.description: The account you sign in with, and how to end it.
account.deleteSectionBody: Removes you from every workspace on this server and takes your name off everything you wrote. This cannot be undone.
account.deleteBody: You will be signed out and removed from every workspace here. Your name and email are erased. This cannot be undone.
account.retained: The {comments, plural, =0 {no comments} one {one comment} other {# comments}} and {tasks, plural, =0 {no tasks} one {one task} other {# tasks}} you wrote stay where they are, credited to “Deleted user”.
account.ownedTitle: You are the only owner of these. Decide what happens to each one.
account.ownedWorkspace: {name} — {members, plural, one {# member} other {# members}}, {boards, plural, one {# board} other {# boards}}
account.ownedDelete: Delete this workspace and everything in it
account.ownedNobodyLeft: Nobody else is in this workspace, so it can only be deleted.
account.deleteErrorConfirm: That is not the address of this account. Check it and try again.
account.deleteErrorTransferGone: The person you picked is no longer in that workspace. Reopen this and choose again.
account.deleteErrorUndecided: Something changed while you were deciding. Reopen this to see what is left.

activation.title: Instance activation
activation.description: How far people get on this server, from signing up to a team that keeps coming back. Counted from what this instance already stores; nothing here is sent anywhere.

northStar.help: A workspace counts as an active team when two or more of its current members did something in it — edited a card, or simply opened a board. The two figures beside it are the context: how many workspaces saw any activity at all, and how many have more than one member to begin with.

activation.peopleCount: {count, plural, =0 {no one} one {# person} other {# people}}
activation.localOnly: These numbers are computed on this server and shown only to the accounts you listed as instance administrators. Kurul sends nothing outside this server unless you switch telemetry on yourself.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.emptyBody: Charts fill in as tasks are created and moved.

board.listSubtitle: Open a board to divide the work.
board.unavailable: This board doesn't exist, or you don't have access to it.
board.loadingMore: Loading the rest of the tasks…
board.emptyBody: A board is where the work gets divided. Start with one.
board.deleteBody: Deleting {name} removes its columns and tasks. This cannot be undone.
board.name: Name

import.title: Import from Trello
import.description: Pick the JSON export of a single Trello board. Lists become columns, cards become tasks, and attachments come across as links.
import.duplicateWarning: Importing the same export again creates a second board. This importer never updates an existing one, so run it twice and you will have two.
import.slowWarning: A large board can take a couple of minutes. Once the import starts it cannot be cancelled — leave this tab open.
import.error: The import failed and nothing was created.
import.forbidden: You need admin access to import a board. Ask a workspace owner.
import.tooLarge: That export is larger than this instance accepts.
import.badFile: That file isn't a Trello board export.
import.tooMany: Too many imports in a row. Wait a minute and try again.
import.notSaved: This report is not saved anywhere. Dismissing it is permanent — it cannot be shown again. The board itself is unaffected.

imported.checklistItems: {count, plural, one {# checklist item} other {# checklist items}}
imported.attachments: {count, plural, one {# attachment link} other {# attachment links}}

import.skippedTitle: What did not come across as-is
import.nothingSkipped: Everything in the export came across.
import.samples: Showing {shown} of {count, plural, one {# example} other {# examples}}

scope.label: {count, plural, one {# label} other {# labels}}
scope.checklistItem: {count, plural, one {# checklist item} other {# checklist items}}

reason.outOfScope: {count, plural, one {{items} was not imported: Kurul has no equivalent for it.} other {{items} were not imported: Kurul has no equivalent for them.}}
reason.archived: {count, plural, one {{items} was not imported: it was archived in Trello, and Kurul has no archive.} other {{items} were not imported: they were archived in Trello, and Kurul has no archive.}}
reason.unmappable: {count, plural, one {{items} was not imported: a Trello account is not a Kurul account, so the assignment was dropped.} other {{items} were not imported: a Trello account is not a Kurul account, so the assignments were dropped.}}
reason.unsupportedScheme: {count, plural, one {{items} was not imported: its address was neither http nor https.} other {{items} were not imported: their addresses were neither http nor https.}}
reason.malformed: {count, plural, one {{items} was not imported: the export did not carry the fields the importer needs.} other {{items} were not imported: the export did not carry the fields the importer needs.}}
reason.defaulted: {count, plural, one {{items} came across changed: Kurul had no matching value, so the default was used.} other {{items} came across changed: Kurul had no matching value, so the default was used.}}
